metaDesc: AXEM-SX 1.0.1 support — first-command quick start, troubleshooting FAQ, and how to reach the team for bugs and feedback.
heroSub: You landed here from your AXEM-SX desktop, or from a link on the site. Either way — welcome. The pages below cover the few things most people ask after a fresh install.
quickIntro: The AXEM-SX 1.0.1 ISO is intentionally slim. After install, one zypper line unlocks the full curated experience — LibreOffice, Inkscape, VLC, codecs, Flatpak with Flathub, and the guided third-party installer.
quickFooter: Each *-full package is a wrapper. Uninstalling it does not remove the apps. You stay in control.
faqIntro: The handful of things that come up often, with the exact fix.
faq1Q: Black screen during install or first boot
faq1A: Reboot, and at the GRUB / installer menu press e to edit the kernel line. Add nomodeset at the end of the linux line, then press F10 or Ctrl-X to boot. Common on older NVIDIA / Optimus laptops. Once installed, the persistent fix is to install the proper NVIDIA driver via the AXEM Control Hub.
faq2Q: Trash and Home icons appeared on my Pro desktop
faq2A: Cosmetic only — a Plasma containment / pcmanfm-qt artifact on first login. Right-click each icon and remove. AXEM Pro routes Trash through the top panel by design; it is not lost.
faq3Q: zypper complains about a bad repository
faq3A: List your repos with sudo zypper lr, identify the bad one (often added by the installer), and remove it: sudo zypper rr <number-or-alias>. Then refresh: sudo zypper ref. The AXEM-SX repo and Packman repo (opt-in) are the only third-party sources we ship.
faq4Q: Some videos or H.265 / AAC files won't play
faq4A: Run the Packman vendor swap once: sudo /usr/bin/axem-sx-codecs-upgrade-to-packman. This enables full multimedia codec coverage (H.265, AAC encode, etc.). One-time switch.
faq5Q: I want Spotify, Discord, VS Code, or Anti-Gravity
faq5A: Run axem-sx-install-thirdparty in a terminal. A whiptail menu lets you pick what you want — installed via Flathub or upstream OBS. No surprises, no auto-installs.
faq6Q: How do I keep the system up to date?
faq6A: sudo zypper update — standard openSUSE Leap 16.0 maintenance. Always safe, always Leap-compatible. AXEM-SX adds curated identity on top of a real Leap install.
liveBody: Both the Light and Pro ISOs boot into a live session. No installation required to try things out.
liveTip: Log in with user axem and password axem to access the full live desktop.
reachBody: AXEM-SX is built in the open. The fastest way to reach the team is the GitHub issue tracker — bug reports, hardware compatibility notes, ideas, criticism. All welcome.
reachNote: We read every issue. We do not collect emails, names, or any user data on this site or in the OS — there is nothing to subscribe to. The tracker is where the conversation happens.
